meaning: Five exploratory signal observers only, admitted by user despite recorded delay failures. Their separate paper ledger uses fresh quotes; no actual orders.
data_authentication: Caller-supplied OHLCV CSV. Structural integrity and stored bytes are checked; exchange origin is not authenticated by this journal.
integrity_limit: Local hashes and replay detect inconsistency, not coordinated rewriting by a privileged attacker. No external timestamp or signature.
snapshot_policy: Full anchored history from2019-01-01; immutable seed prefix and append-only observed candle history. Missing observation days remain missing even when their prices are needed for indicators. Recursive ADX state is never restarted at a moving200-bar boundary.
